top_fixes.rule: Plan/lower instalments/more time requests: describe nothing, `transfer_to_agent` queue `restructuring`, close transferred TRS.
top_fixes.why: If a customer in hardship asks for a plan, lower instalments or more time, the agent says it can't offer that instead of calling transfer_to_agent with queue restructuring, so close_call never gets transferred/TRS and the case fails.
top_fixes.fix: hardship node: (1) add a 'new_plan' value to the extraction_schema field (e.g. topic) with the description 'customer wants a payment plan, lower instalments or more time'. (2) Add a transition topic equals "new_plan" -> xfer_restructuring, placed before the other hardship routes. (3) In task_message, replace the 'say you cannot offer that' line for plan requests with: 'If the customer asks for a plan, lower instalments or more time, do not describe or promise any option; say you will pass them to a colleague and transfer.' Check that xfer_restructuring calls transfer_to_agent with queue 'restructuring' and that its fin node sets outcome='transferred', reason='TRS'.

top_fixes.rule: Every `close_call` carries one outcome from `promise`, `paid`, `transferred`, `no_promise`, `not_verified`, `not_reached` and exactly one code in `reason`; a close without a code is rejected.
top_fixes.why: If the call ends before setup has run (an early hang-up or an engine error), close_call is sent without a reason code and is rejected, so the case has no valid outcome.
top_fixes.fix: tool close_call pre_process_code: replace `if not b.get('reason'): b.pop('reason', None)` with `if not b.get('reason'): b['reason'] = 'UNC'; b['outcome'] = 'not_reached'`. Also add `if b.get('outcome') not in ('promise','paid','transferred','no_promise','not_verified','not_reached'): b['outcome'] = 'not_reached'`, so every close sends exactly one valid outcome and one reason code.
